feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Evidence: iteration 5 (five sensors at ±0.04 m, y 0.06 m, 12 mm footprints, wheel_track 0.095 m, mass 0.6 kg, kp 3.5, kd 0.6) scored 465.8, the best so far. Its oval finish was 0.95 and s-bend max_error 0.0591 m, but s-bend line loss stayed near 0.95 and 16 of 20 s-bend runs still ended off track. Iterations 6 to 9 showed that widening the span cuts s-bend line loss but costs the oval (iteration 6), that y 0.07 m pushes s-bend max_error past the limit (iteration 7), that the interpolated row also loses (iteration 8, 432.4), and that a 16 mm footprint is worse (iteration 9, 373.0). So the span, forward offset and footprint are each tuned near their best. For this candidate, I keep the controller unchanged (kp 3.5, kd 0.6, ki 0.2, base_speed 1.4), so the race reads the mass change alone. Read the next race as follows. If s-bend max_error falls below 0.059 m and the oval finish holds at 0.95 with s-bend oscillation under about 0.38, mass is working and the next step is a further mass cut toward 0.4 kg. If the oval falls below 0.95 or s-bend oscillation rises above about 0.43 with no fall in max_error, lower mass is adding slip or jitter, so return to 0.6 kg. If max_error stays near 0.059 to 0.060 m with line loss still near 0.95, the remaining s-bend limit is controller-side, and I will handle it there rather than change geometry again.
requested_changes: If s-bend max_error falls below 0.059 m and the oval finish holds at 0.95 or above with s-bend steering_oscillation under about 0.38, try mass 0.4 kg (the contract minimum) with the same five-sensor row at ±0.04 m, y 0.06 m, and 12 mm footprints. Evidence: iteration 5 gave s-bend max_error 0.0591 m at mass 0.6 kg, and lower mass cuts yaw inertia.

If the oval finish falls below 0.95, or s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.43 with no fall in max_error, return mass to 0.6 kg and keep the iteration 5 row. Evidence: iteration 5 oval finish was 0.95 with oscillation 0.23, and s-bend oscillation was 0.38 at 0.6 kg.

Keep wheel_track at 0.095 m and the five-sensor row at ±0.04 m, y 0.06 m, 12 mm footprints for any mass test. Evidence: iteration 6 (±0.05 m) lowered the oval finish to 0.90, iteration 7 (y 0.07 m) pushed s-bend max_error to 0.0626 m, and iteration 9 (16 mm footprint) scored 373.0, so the sensor row is near its best.
